description: This file defines the LocationModel class within the OrangeHRM project. It serves as a data model for serializing location-related information, including properties like country, city, address, and contact details. The class uses traits and annotations to facilitate API serialization and normalization, reflecting the structure of the Location entity.

classes.description: A model class for serializing Location entity data for API responses, including location details and related country information.
